items.title: 中国客流不振，开云王牌复苏遇冷：Gucci Q3销售下滑6%
items.summary: Gucci Q3 comparable sales fell 6% to EUR1.291bn versus about 3.3% decline expected; directly operated stores down 9%. Kering blames lower footfall in mainland China and Japan; 105 net store closures in nine months, at least 125 targeted for the year.

items.title: Kering faces setback as Gucci revenue falls in China
items.summary: Reuters report: Gucci Q3 sales fell to EUR1.29bn on weak China traffic; Gucci is about half of Kering group profit; leadership shake-ups add outlook doubt.

items.title: Kering turnaround hopes hit by drop in Gucci sales
items.summary: Gucci down 6% in Q3 as shoppers stayed away; China traffic is the main problem after three-plus years of decline. Demna nears first full year under pressure; first sneakers reportedly produced in China.

items.title: How the third quarter shows luxury industry can't rely on walk-ins anymore
items.summary: Gucci traffic is the constraint in APAC (China, Japan) while conversion and prices held; Hermes grew 9.6% in Japan and Korea was a bright spot, contrasting Gucci's slump.

items.title: Kering stock: Gucci sales fall 6% as Q3 revenue stays flat
items.summary: Financial wire recap of Kering Q3: Gucci comparable -6%, group revenue flat; footfall in Asia Pacific cited.
